## Rules on access to the BSL2 area (CLA J26)

- Access to CLA J26 is restricted to persons authorized by the BSO. The door is kept closed and locked; it carries the biohazard sign, the sign "Access for authorized personnel only", and the [door rules](../_operational/10_wet_lab_door_rules.qmd).
- Authorization requires the Moodle test *Safety in the laboratory*, the biosafety introduction by the BSO (including maternity protection information), and a signed training record ([Operational Safety, Appendix 8](../_operational/08_training_certificates.qmd)).
- Only persons listed in [Appendix 2](02_list_of_employees_SAMV.qmd) work with Group 2 organisms. Other authorized users may work in the lab but do not handle Group 2 material.
- Keys are issued by the group's key manager for a limited period. When a person leaves GHE or the access period ends, the key is returned and the end date is entered below.
- CLA J26 is not open to visitors. Service personnel (technicians, building services) enter only with permission of the BSO or the BSO deputy, accompanied by an authorized person, after being informed about the risks. Before service work, Group 2 material is stored away and the affected equipment is decontaminated.
- Emergency services can access the room with the fire brigade key at any time.
- The BSO reviews this list at least every six months.
